reviews.title: Works great absolutely love it
reviews.comment: Got this for my first pc build. The quality is great and it looks beautiful! Have not had a chance to try the wifi where I prefer ethernet but the fact it came with its own little wifi adapter is awesome. It was very easy to work with and install. Fits the aesthetic I'm working on very well!
reviews.author: Julia
